capabilities: prototype: verifier-accepted Ethernet IPv4 XDP parser on the recorded CI kernel
prototype: exact IPv4 source-address hash map with 4096-entry capacity
prototype: XDP_DROP only for explicit source-address map matches with action value 1
prototype: unmatched, non-IPv4, VLAN-tagged, IPv6, malformed, and unsupported paths return XDP_PASS
prototype: offline versioned IPv4 ingress rule validation and deterministic map-update preview
verified in CI: map update and synthetic BPF_PROG_TEST_RUN checks for drop and pass paths
not implemented: operator-facing BPF loader, map updater, map pinning lifecycle, or interface attach/detach
not verified: live interface traffic, NIC/driver compatibility, or cross-kernel support
not implemented: IPv6, VLAN parsing, CIDR, transport ports, counters, or rate limiting
negative_scope: fabricated or simulated live operational evidence

platforms.target: Ubuntu 24.04 GitHub Actions runner, x86_64, kernel 7.0.0-1014-aws, Clang 18.1.3, bpftool 7.7.0
platforms.notes: Kernel BPF verifier accepted the program. A 4096-entry hash map was created and updated. BPF_PROG_TEST_RUN confirmed exact-match XDP_DROP and default XDP_PASS behavior for unmatched, VLAN-tagged, and truncated IPv4 test frames. No interface attachment occurred.

platforms.target: Other Linux kernels, NICs, drivers, hardware, and live interface attachment
platforms.notes: Not tested. No broad kernel or driver compatibility claim is made.

build: bpftool 7.7.0 for CI-only kernel verifier and BPF_PROG_TEST_RUN checks
runtime: Python standard library for offline rule validation and map preview; no operator-facing loader or map-update runtime is included

interfaces: BPF map: deny_src_ipv4, BPF_MAP_TYPE_HASH, 4096 entries, network-order IPv4 key, one-byte action value
Versioned JSON IPv4 ingress rule schema v1.0

claims.claim: Twelve deterministic rule-validation and map-preview unit tests on Python 3.9 through 3.13 on Ubuntu 24.04.
BPF object compiles with Clang 18.1.3 and contains xdp, .maps, and license ELF sections.
Kernel BPF verifier accepted the program on Ubuntu 24.04 runner kernel 7.0.0-1014-aws; map update and synthetic BPF_PROG_TEST_RUN drop/pass cases passed with bpftool 7.7.0.
Live interface attachment, detach, driver compatibility, and real packet traffic.
